bundle.shortDescription: Automatic Twitch predictions for Valorant matches
bundle.longDescription: ValorPredict automatically opens Twitch Channel Points Predictions when your Valorant match starts and resolves them when it ends. Free and local-first — no ValorPredict server, account, or telemetry upload.
